title: Bölünmüş Dünya
author: Ziya Selçuk
description: The World Asunder explores humanity’s enduring tendency to perceive life through oppositions, and the possibility of moving beyond them. Drawing on the metaphor of an orchestra, where different instruments produce distinct sounds yet create a single harmony, the book invites readers to reconsider the idea of contradiction as separation rather than as part of a greater whole. Ziya Selçuk, educator and former Minister of Education of Turkey, examines how individuals relate to opposing forces within themselves, their societies, and their times.
